done_when: The tests that pin one-off data migrations are deleted, any test-only helpers they alone used are removed, and the full suite passes

findings.body: Deleting this test removes the only real-Postgres check that `healthCheck()` detects a missing identity generator. The remaining test at `apps/core/test/unit/storage/storage-service.test.ts:189` supplies the `missing_generated_identity_primary_keys` result through a mock, so it cannot catch a defect in the catalog query at `apps/core/src/adapters/storage/postgres/storage-service.ts:332`. Keep coverage of the live readiness behavior in a separate test while removing the one-off migration replay.
findings.title: Not done: the real-Postgres identity drift readiness test

why: Five tests only re-check one-off data migrations that already ran on the only live database, keeping legacy data shapes alive in the test suite
